Great Morning Brunch
Oct 2019 • Friends
I was here during the storm coming to the land. I stayed up all night long in the room. On the next morning, one staff knocked the door for cleaning up the room. He told me that there was brunch waiting me at the dinning room. I was surprised as I thought with that price, I could only enjoy the room, not the brunch. When I came into the room, there was buffet brunch which was really amazing. The staff was pretty caring, especially the female one named “Nữ”. She sat next to me all the time and took a good care for me whenever I need something. Both Oriental and Western foods were served and great.
